content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be incomplete, unclear, or incorrect. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code verify feedback before changing code.
actual_capabilities: Separates review comments into bugs, preferences, performance concerns, and security concerns.
Prompts verification of feedback before code changes are made.
Provides response patterns for agreement, clarification, disagreement, and evidence requests.
Encourages checking project standards and existing implementation patterns.
Supports tracking review-driven changes in EXECUTION_LOG.md.
limitations: It does not run tests or inspect code by itself.
It does not decide reviewer intent when feedback is unclear.
It cannot replace human judgment on project standards.
It references companion flow-review materials that may not be packaged with the skill.

use_cases.title: Triage Pull Request Feedback
use_cases.description: Classify each review comment and decide whether to implement, clarify, or challenge it with evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare Review Responses
use_cases.description: Draft clear replies that acknowledge valid issues, ask precise questions, or explain technical trade-offs.

use_cases.title: Coach Review Discipline
use_cases.description: Teach developers to avoid blind agreement and verify reviewer claims before changing code.

prompt_templates.title: Verify One Comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use flow-receiving-review on this reviewer comment: [paste comment]. Tell me if it is a bug, preference, performance issue, or security concern.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these review comments with flow-receiving-review. For each one, decide whether to accept, ask for clarification, or push back with evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Review Replies
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply flow-receiving-review to draft concise replies for these comments. Include the evidence I should gather before changing code.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Full Review Cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Use flow-receiving-review as a review-response checklist for this pull request. Map comments to fixes, risks, tests, and final responses.

output_examples.input: A reviewer says the caching change is unsafe but gives no reproduction steps.
output_examples.output: The skill would classify the comment as unclear, request reproduction details, and avoid changing the cache logic until evidence is available.

output_examples.input: A reviewer suggests renaming a helper for style consistency.
output_examples.output: The skill would identify a style preference, check project naming patterns, and accept the change if it matches established conventions.

output_examples.input: A reviewer reports a possible security issue in authentication handling.
output_examples.output: The skill would treat the comment as high priority, verify the attack scenario, test the fix, and document the result in the response.

best_practices: Read every reviewer comment fully before planning changes.
Collect evidence through tests, reproduction steps, or project standards.
Explain trade-offs clearly when you disagree with a suggestion.
anti_patterns: Implementing a requested change before understanding the concern.
Rejecting feedback without evidence or a clear alternative.
Treating style preferences as defects without checking project norms.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents process code review feedback with verification, evidence, and clear responses.

faq.question: Does it automatically change code?
faq.answer: No. It guides the decision process before code changes are made.

faq.question: Can it challenge reviewer feedback?
faq.answer: Yes. It encourages respectful disagreement when evidence shows the feedback is incorrect.

faq.question: Is it useful for security review comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It tells the agent to identify security concerns and verify the suggested fix.

faq.question: Does it require other files?
faq.answer: The main guidance is in SKILL.md, but it references related flow-review materials.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
